request.initial_prompt: _Ford._ In good sadness, sir, I am sorry that for my sake you have suffered all this. My suit, then, is desperate; 110 you'll undertake her no more?

raw_segments.text: Host, let him die. She, thy impatience, Throw cold water on thy collar. Go about the fields
With me through frogmore. I will bring thee Where mistress and page is at a farmhouse
Of feasting, and thou shalt woo her. Cried eighty, I aim, said I well.
